---
title: "Oil is Found in the Minds of Men"
date: "2009-09-19"
categories: ["Commodity Prices", "Economics", "Financial Markets", "Oil"]
---

And ‘peak oil’ is founded on ignorance, argues [Peter Foster](http://network.nationalpost.com/np/blogs/fullcomment/archive/2009/09/08/peter-foster-oil-and-the-minds-of-men.aspx "Peter Foster"):

> *Peak Oil theory represents a combination of economic ignorance and moral rejection of markets as greed-driven and short-sighted. These all-too common attitudes usually go with a profound faith in effective government policy, despite the monumental weight of evidence to the contrary.*
